threads.body: [General] This recognizes any name with the prefix and class-hash suffix, even though Tomcat's generated format requires the middle segment to be an integer counter. For example, an explicitly configured `Tomcat Connection Pool[orders-<class hash>]` is incorrectly rewritten to `jdbc-*`, contradicting the requirement to preserve configured names. Validate the counter segment before treating the name as generated.

Pending the discussion in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/19160#discussion_r3564889077, I think we should avoid process-local `-N` suffixes here. If no stable name exists, use a stable fallback and let duplicates merge so metric identities remain consistent across restarts.
The original test deliberately called both `createPool()` and `close()` twice, which we no longer have coverage for. Maybe we could update the assertConnectionPoolMetrics helper to add it back?

are these shadow configs needed? if so, can we add a comment explaining why? Every other module needing JDBC classes on the test agent uses `testInstrumentation(project(":instrumentation:jdbc:javaagent"))`
